tools.name: spokephone_list_calls
tools.description: List call records (oldest first by default; pass sortOrder descending for the latest calls), with caller, direction, duration, assigned user/team and recording URLs. Filter by time window or the external party's number. Returns { meta: { next }, calls }.

tools.name: spokephone_get_call
tools.description: Get one call record by call id.

tools.name: spokephone_get_call_recording
tools.description: Get the details and download URL of one recording of a call.

tools.name: spokephone_list_call_content_analysis
tools.description: List the Enlighten AI content-analysis results (summaries etc.) stored for one call.

tools.name: spokephone_list_directory
tools.description: List or search the unified Spoke directory (users, teams, devices) with extensions and live availability. Exactly one of extension, phoneNumber or ivrKey may be used to look up an entry. Returns { meta: { next }, entries }.

tools.name: spokephone_get_directory_entry
tools.description: Get one directory entry (user, team or device) by entry id.

tools.name: spokephone_list_users
tools.description: List active Spoke users with real-time availability. Optionally filter by email address.

tools.name: spokephone_get_user
tools.description: Get one Spoke user with availability, by user id.

tools.name: spokephone_list_teams
tools.description: List Spoke teams (call groups) with their members and availability.

tools.name: spokephone_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations of the organisation.

tools.name: spokephone_get_location
tools.description: Get one location by id.

tools.name: spokephone_list_location_users
tools.description: List the users assigned to one location.

tools.name: spokephone_list_phonebooks
tools.description: List shared phonebooks (the CRM contact containers used for caller ID), each with its contacts. Use limit 0 to list phonebooks without contacts.

tools.name: spokephone_get_phonebook
tools.description: Get one phonebook and a page of its contacts. The id may also be a user's email address for that user's personal phonebook.

tools.name: spokephone_get_phonebook_contact
tools.description: Get one contact of a phonebook.

tools.name: spokephone_list_transcripts
tools.description: List call and voicemail transcripts. Filter by time window or source.

tools.name: spokephone_get_transcript
tools.description: Get one transcript by id.

tools.name: spokephone_get_transcript_segments
tools.description: Get the per-speaker segments of one transcript.

tools.name: spokephone_list_content_analysis
tools.description: List AI content-analysis results (needs the Enlighten entitlement). Filter by time, source, participant or artifact name.

tools.name: spokephone_get_content_analysis
tools.description: Get one content-analysis result by id.

tools.name: spokephone_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions of the account.

tools.name: spokephone_get_webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook subscription by id.

tools.name: spokephone_list_trunks
tools.description: List the SIP trunks that overlay a legacy PBX onto Spoke.

tools.name: spokephone_get_trunk
tools.description: Get one SIP trunk by id.

tools.name: spokephone_send_sms
tools.description: WRITE: send a real SMS to a phone number (or a group MMS to several) from a company number or from a Spoke user's conversation number. The message appears in the Spoke conversation. Confirm the recipient and text with the user first. Needs an SMS-enabled number. POST /conversationMessages.

tools.name: spokephone_save_phonebook_contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to a phonebook, REPLACING any contact there with the same contactId (other contacts are untouched). The phonebook id may be a user's email for a personal phonebook. Contacts feed caller ID. PUT /phonebooks/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: spokephone_delete_phonebook_contact
tools.description: WRITE, destructive: delete one contact from a phonebook (it stops showing in caller ID). DELETE /phonebooks/{id}/contacts/{contactId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spokephone_list_calls, spokephone_get_call_recording, spokephone_list_users, spokephone_get_phonebook, spokephone_list_transcripts, spokephone_get_transcript, spokephone_get_transcript_segments · Private data: spokephone_list_calls, spokephone_get_call, spokephone_list_phonebooks, spokephone_get_phonebook, spokephone_get_phonebook_contact, spokephone_save_phonebook_contact, spokephone_delete_phonebook_contact · Public sink: spokephone_list_users, spokephone_get_phonebook, spokephone_list_webhooks, spokephone_get_webhook, spokephone_send_sms, spokephone_save_phonebook_contact · Destructive: spokephone_delete_phonebook_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spokephone_list_calls, spokephone_get_call_recording, spokephone_list_users, spokephone_get_phonebook, spokephone_list_transcripts, spokephone_get_transcript, spokephone_get_transcript_segments · Private data: spokephone_list_calls, spokephone_get_call, spokephone_list_phonebooks, spokephone_get_phonebook, spokephone_get_phonebook_contact, spokephone_save_phonebook_contact, spokephone_delete_phonebook_contact · Public sink: spokephone_list_users, spokephone_get_phonebook, spokephone_list_webhooks, spokephone_get_webhook, spokephone_send_sms, spokephone_save_phonebook_contact · Destructive: spokephone_delete_phonebook_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
